title: Person
description: A household member or guest. Core holds the birthdate; packages only ever see age_range, derived server-side and never stored on the record a package can read. See platform plan 3.1 and 4.2.

id.description: Stable id, never reused, even after deletedAt is set.

nickname.description: What a companion calls this person, if different from display_name.

birthdate.description: Core only. Never present in any shape a package's ctx exposes; packages see age_range on Person derived from this.

role.description: The role ladder (4.2). Two minor bands (teen 13-17, child under 13) so there is no thirteen-year cliff.

avatar_seed.description: Deterministic seed for a generated avatar; never a photo of a real person by default.

source.description: hub: authoritative on the hub, replicated to robots. local: a robot-only guest, never synced to the hub (4.2's local_only concept for a whole person).

local_only.description: Keeps this person off the overlay network entirely (4.2, 4.12).
